title: Recruitment and case management capabilities for HR service projects
description: Save time and streamline your hiring process with new recruitment and case management capabilities in Jira Service Management. When you create a new company-managed project using the HR Service Management template, you can now include dedicated tools for managing candidates and requisitions alongside case management features.
